items.title: With the news that the Wolves plan to waive-and-stretch John Konchar, that means that the trade with the Jazz should be completed today.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
With the news that the Wolves plan to waive-and-stretch John Konchar, that means that the trade with the Jazz should be completed today.

If teams plan to waive-and-stretch a player, they have to waive the player by today. This is so the player will clear waivers by August 31.

items.title: After trading Josh Green + waiving and stretching John Konchar, the Timberwolves are $4.5 million below the second apron with an open roster spot for a vet minimum
items.author: Ryan Eichten
items.body_excerpt:
After trading Josh Green + waiving and stretching John Konchar, the Timberwolves are $4.5 million below the second apron with an open roster spot for a vet minimum

The Wolves could open up a second vet min spot if they were to waive Trey Lyles before his guarantee date (1/10/27)
